messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] metric_threshold: queue_processor.backlog.size > 5000 (prod-us-east-1)
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: page fired -> PD-INC12345, primary: mira (oncall)
mira (oncall): acked. I'm jumping in. seeing steady growth, backlog ~5.4k and climbing. any recent deploys?
sam (eng-oncall): no deploys from my side. autoscaler reports: goal pods=45 actual=32, scale-up requests queued.
alex (eng-sre): confirming — autoscaler stuck in cool-down. saw API throttling errors in the controller logs. snippet: ```E0621 04:15:12 scaler.go:234] scale up failed: rate limited by cloud api (429)```
ryan (eng-runtime): we had a short blip to the cloud provider control plane ~10m ago. most calls retried but autoscaler backoff seems to be compounding.
mira (oncall): impact: customer-facing inference latency stepping from 120ms->1.2s; tail QPS dropping, a handful of 503s reported by frontend. marking customer-impact: partial degradation.
sam (eng-oncall): mitigation options: 1) manual scale the node pool / reserved capacity (fast), 2) relax autoscaler cooldowns (risk), 3) drain low-priority queues to batch worker (complex).
alex (eng-sre): manual step first. I'll request a manual node add and scale replicas to 60 temporarily. can someone run the scale command?
ryan (eng-runtime): running now: ```# scale replicas up kubectl -n inference scale deploy/queue-processor --replicas=60```
ryan (eng-runtime): also bumped node pool min from 10->20 in cloud console to give room for new pods. cloud request pending (ticket 87654).
mira (oncall): good. watching metrics. backlog growth slowed but still around 4.6k. latency improving but not back to normal yet.
sam (eng-oncall): autoscaler logs show resumed activity, but still a few 429s. alex, can you check controller retry/backoff and maybe reset the cooldown?
alex (eng-sre): resetting cool-down and clearing backoff. command: ```kubectl annotate deployment/queue-processor autoscaler.k8s.io/retry-reset=true``` (internal helper). doing now.
alex (eng-sre): done. autoscaler started new scale-up decisions, pods coming up.
incident-bot: NOTE: PD-INC12345 updated: status -> acknowledged by mira (oncall)
mira (oncall): assigning follow-up: alex to root cause, sam to postmortem, ryan to capacity runbook. I'll stay on the thread until handoff.
sam (eng-oncall): drafting a blameless postmortem skeleton in #postmortems. will include timeline and mitigation steps.
ryan (eng-runtime): monitoring node provisioning logs — cloud API still sporadic but within acceptable retry windows now. provisioning ETA ~6m.
mira (oncall): customer communication: sending out a brief status note to affected customers. snippet: "We're seeing elevated inference latency due to a scaling delay; we're actively scaling and expect recovery soon. No data loss."
alex (eng-sre): initial RCA hypothesis: transient cloud control-plane rate limiting led autoscaler backoff; autoscaler backoff did not surface clear alerts earlier. action: add control-plane 429 alarm and circuit-breaker to switch to manual-reserve when backoff exceeds X.
sam (eng-oncall): PD escalation plan: if backlog >6k or >5m sustained, escalate to SRE lead and paging rotation. current backlog trajectory: flattening.
mira (oncall): recovery observed. backlog down to 900 and falling. response times back to baseline ~140ms. I'm going to resolve the PD incident once we hit stable for 15m.
PagerDuty: PD-INC12345 acknowledged by mira (oncall) at 1939876550; escalation not required.
incident-bot: Automated post-incident checklist queued.
mira (oncall): handoff: I'll stay for 10 more minutes then hand to sam for follow-up. please upload logs and the commands you ran to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
sam (eng-oncall): copying commands and logs into the doc now. starting postmortem draft.
alex (eng-sre): opened CR to add 429 monitoring for cloud API and fallback policy. PR #4287.
ryan (eng-runtime): adding runbook note to inflight-scaling.md about manual node bump and the helper annotation we used.
mira (oncall): closing notes: root cause likely provider-side rate limiting -> autoscaler backoff chain -> capacity exhaustion -> queue backlog. mitigation worked: manual node bump + reset backoff + increase replica target. follow-ups: automate fallback and add runbook steps. resolving in 10m if stable. :white_check_mark:
